def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The grid is a 5-by-3 arrangement of rooms divided by complete
    # rows/columns of color 9. Mark a room 1 when it contains at least
    # two cells of color 4; otherwise mark it with its background color 8.
    sep = 9
    hr = [r for r in range(h) if all(x == sep for x in grid[r])]
    vc = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    rb, cb = [-1] + hr + [h], [-1] + vc + [w]
    out = []
    for i in range(len(rb) - 1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(cb) - 1):
            cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(rb[i] + 1, rb[i + 1])
                     for c in range(cb[j] + 1, cb[j + 1])]
            row.append(1 if cells.count(4) >= 2 else 8)
        out.append(row)
    return out
